description: Pending owner decision (asked 2026-09-29, deferred). What exists: Upstash-compatible Redis REST (valkey-gateway, T-027), dply Messages (QStash-compatible Worker, T-029, flag resource-messages), Vector REST (T-030, on app Workers). All are product-neutral: a separate product would add its own brand/site/sign-up/billing and org-level (not app-level) Valkey and vector indexes. Record the decision as a storybloq ruling; then T-032 (Messages launch) and pricing (REST $0.10/100K commands, Messages $0.50/100K) follow from it.
title: Owner decision: ship Redis REST / Messages / Vector as a separate product, or inside dply
